rationale: Price at $33.63 has broken the $33.66 invalidation level, and the final 1-minute candle (~207k shares, 20-40x the prior minutes' volume) dropping from 33.80 to close near its low confirms the volume-absorption thesis failed — the large buyers at 33.75+ did not hold. The relative-strength edge has also faded (SPY improved to -0.67%, VIXY cooled to +2.11%), so a flip-to-short lacks an edge strong enough to justify re-crossing the spread into a name still above VWAP and up 1.6% on the day; exiting realizes a small ~$42 loss well inside the remaining $566 budget.
